page.overview:
What is Septim Empire?

Septim Empire belongs to The Elder Scrolls. The Third Empire, also known as the Septim Empire, Cyrodilic Empire, or Tamrielic Empire, is an empire founded by the conqueror Tiber Septim in the late Second Era.

The Septim Dynasty ruled the Third Empire during the Third Era, but the bloodline was extinguished in the Oblivion Crisis; the Mede Dynasty rose to power in the early Fourth Era and has held the Imperial throne ever since.

At its height, the Third Empire spanned across the entire continent of Tamriel and small colonial territories on Akavir and the island nations of Cathnoquey, Esroniet, Yneslea and Roscrea, it administered feudal control through the nine provinces, with an Emperor or Empress acting as supreme ruler.

The Empire's prosperity was the driving force behind the ushering in of the Third Era.

Also known as: Third Empire, Empire of Tamriel, Empire.
